num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum total weight each vehicle can carry.
scheduling_horizon: <int> Latest time by which all vehicles must return to the depot.

cost_function.a: <int> Slope of the linear weight-related cost function applied to the load weight on each edge.
cost_function.b: <float> Intercept of the linear weight-related cost function, representing the cost attributable to the vehicle's own curb weight.

depot.id: <int> Index of the depot node in the distance matrix.
depot.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest time at which vehicles may depart from or return to the depot.
depot.service_time: <int> Time spent at the depot for loading or unloading.
depot.demand: <int> Delivery demand at the depot, always zero.

customers.id: <int> Unique index of the customer in the distance matrix.
customers.x: <int> Horizontal coordinate of the customer location.
customers.y: <int> Vertical coordinate of the customer location.
customers.demand: <int> Total weight of goods that must be delivered to this customer.
customers.time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest and latest time at which service may begin at this customer.
customers.service_time: <int> Time a vehicle must spend at this customer per visit, regardless of delivery quantity.

distance_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers+1][num_customers+1]> Travel distance between each pair of locations, where row and column 0 is the depot and rows/columns 1 through num_customers are customers.
